name: Palomar Gas Transmission Pipeline

values.EndLocation: Columbia River northwest of Portland, with Molalla interconnect

researcher_notes: Not an existing row. The nearest roster row is P2626, a 106 mile, 30 inch Northwest Gas Pipeline segment from Madras to Molalla that is a different, later proposal. Palomar was a 217 mile, 36 inch line proposed by TransCanada and NW Natural, with a FERC application filed December 11, 2008 and withdrawn in early 2009 (Oregon Business). The company release gives the length, diameter, 1.3 Bcf per day capacity, start at the GTN pipeline and a Molalla interconnect. The Federal Register notice of January 5 2009 (E8-31313, not cited as value source) gives 216.9 miles and 1.4 Bcf per day, so capacity differs slightly by document. Owner is the joint venture company; parents are TransCanada Corporation and Northwest Natural Gas Company. No exact match for these parents was found in the owner list, so Parent is left blank for a person to style. ProposalYear 2008 is the year of the FERC application (earlier trade press from October 2007 was not opened). The route was not found, so route is marked unavailable. The project is far above the 25 km length threshold.
